brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, Israel's chief opposition candidate, warned in a video statement Thursday that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is conducting a campaign to delegitimise election results, according to Middle East Eye. Eisenkot did not elaborate on specific methods Netanyahu is using to undermine the electoral process.

The warning marks an escalation in rhetoric between the two political rivals ahead of upcoming Israeli elections.
dek: Eisenkot warns Netanyahu is attempting to deligitmise the elections Gadi Eisenkot, Israel's chief opposition candidate, issued a video statement on Thursday warning that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is running a campaign to delegitimise election results.
title: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of delegitimising Israeli elections
